svg.text: CLumo / Controls & display
Default assignments · Android / iPhone
01 8×8 LED matrix
Control animations and saved standby content.
Audio visualization with the Android app.
02 Three LEDs: volume
Android: actual volume from the connected app.
iPhone: via AMS, no app required.
If volume is unknown, LEDs sweep as you turn.
03 Power indicator
The lower orange window indicates power.
04 Left / right buttons
Left: Previous / Right: Next
05 Rotary knob
Turn: volume / Press once: play or pause
Double press: next / Triple press: previous
Customize the controls
Change assignments in the Android app or Wi-Fi editor; restore defaults anytime.
Fixed hold gestures
Hold knob 3 seconds: pair a new phone (60-second window)
Hold both buttons 3 seconds: enter / leave Wi-Fi setup
Normal Bluetooth operation stops during Wi-Fi setup.
Illustrative lit render. All-on LEDs do not represent an actual volume value or display state.
